svg.title: Four common distribution families
svg.desc: A 2-by-2 comparison of Bernoulli with p 0.4, binomial with n 20 and p 0.4, Poisson distributions with rates 2 5 and 10, and normal distributions with parameters mu 0 sigma 1, mu 2 sigma 0.5, and mu 0 sigma 2.
svg.text: Left: individual probabilities (PMFs). Right: continuous probability densities (PDFs).
